Ravi P.: Heads-up: HelixCare submitted a DPA + vendor security form. They want: SOC2 certificate (type II), mapping to product controls, a simplified dataflow image, KMS/BYOK proof or formal attestation, embeddings retention period + deletion procedure, and 90-day access logs. Renewal visibility = 6 weeks. Who can triage?
Maya (CS): I can lead. Quick note: HelixCare called out 'embeddings containing PHI' as a risk factor. We should confirm that first.
Aaron L.: I'll verify where embeddings for HelixCare are stored and whether PHI is present. If PHI, we have to include pseudonymization steps.
Tess (Legal): Do not send full SOC2 report. Provide cert + controls mapping + a short legal caveat. If they insist on full report, require an NDA and scoped purpose.
Maya (CS): Action plan: 1) Confirm PHI in embeddings (Aaron); 2) Pull SOC2 cert + prepare control mapping CSV (Ravi); 3) Draft a KMS attestation (Aaron/Tess) explaining Hosted vs Dedicated options; 4) Request redacted access logs (infra-bot) for last 90 days; 5) Produce cover letter explaining items and next steps.
infra-bot: Request logged: LOG-9421 - access logs request for HelixCare (90d). ETA: 48-72h. Remember to follow redaction playbook.
sec-bot: Reminder: when providing logs, follow https://confluence.redwood/security/redaction and attach a redaction manifest.
Aaron L.: Quick clarification: HelixCare asked for 'KMS provenance'. For Hosted we can provide: cloud-provider CMK attestation + architecture diagram. We can include an attestation template for Dedicated BYOK/HSM.
Maya (CS): Good. Tess, can you draft two short paragraphs we put in the cover: one for encryption at rest explanation, one for legal caveats about SOC2 distribution?
Tess (Legal): Sure. Suggested language: "Attached: SOC2 Type II certificate and a controls-to-product mapping. We do not distribute full SOC2 reports absent a signed NDA and purpose limitation. For encryption, hosted accounts use cloud-provider-managed keys; Dedicated customers can request customer-managed keys (BYOK) and HSM integrations per contract."
Ravi P.: Pasting control mapping template I'll use:
```
Control ID,Control summary,Product area/evidence,File
CC2,Logical access controls,Auth service + RBAC,auth-access-mapping.csv
CC5,Backup & retention,Embeddings store + S3 lifecycle,embeddings-retention.md
CC6,Change management,CI/CD pipeline + release notes,deploy-audit.zip
```
Maya (CS): Timeline: internal bundle ready in 72 hours for Legal review; customer delivery targeted 96 hours after intake. If HelixCare insists on BYOK as non-negotiable, flag account for Sales to propose Dedicated.
Aaron L.: Confirmed: running quick scan to check for PHI markers in embeddings; ETA 24h. If PHI found, I'll include our pseudonymization and deletion SOP snippet.
infra-bot: Logs pulled and queued for redaction (LOG-9421). Will attach redaction manifest to Drive folder when ready.
Maya (CS): Creating Drive folder: /Shared/CS/HelixCare_DPA_bundle_4351234567/. Uploading drafts as available.
Tess (Legal): Also: redact internal ticket IDs and internal-only IP addresses from any artifacts.
Ravi P.: Will assemble the first draft control mapping and SOC2 cert into the Drive folder tonight.
Maya (CS): Thanks team. Risk level = medium-high (conditional on BYOK). I'll open a renewal watch in the account dashboard and ping Sales if the customer pushes BYOK. Reopening thread if any blocker arises. :white_check_mark:
